title: Untitled Discourses on Greed
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 9 Numbered Discourses 9.95–112
  • 10. Rāgapeyyāla 10. Abbreviated Texts Beginning with Greed

~ Untitled Discourses on Greed

“Rāgassa, bhikkhave, pariññāya …pe… “For the complete understanding of greed … parikkhayāya …pe… complete ending … pahānāya …pe… giving up … khayāya …pe… ending … vayāya …pe… vanishing … virāgāya …pe… fading away … nirodhāya …pe… cessation … cāgāya …pe… giving away … paṭinissaggāya …pe… letting go of greed … ime nava dhammā bhāvetabbā”. these nine things should be developed.”
